title: Options that differ in meaning
statement: Check that the options differ in meaning, not just in wording: identical or equivalent options leave more than one right answer and no real distractor.
detail: In two runs of 298 generated items that passed at 3.7% and 3.0%, factual accuracy failed on 78% of items, among them items whose four options were identical (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/archive/old_docs/platform/PATTERN_ANALYSIS_RESULTS.md`, lines 10-11, 21 and 24). A production math generator's wrapper filters equivalent distractors, and its requirements rule out pairs such as 1/2 and 5/10 unless multi-answer is supported (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/qwen3-math/docs/inceptml_full_report.md`, lines 41 and 73). A reading question check flags a distractor that uses different wording for essentially the same meaning as the right answer (`icloud-work/incept/incept-multilingual-generation/src/external_submodules/reading-question-qc/qc_pipeline/config/prompts.json`, line 21).
against: Equivalent options are allowed when every one of them is keyed: the rule holds only "unless multi-answer is supported" (`icloud-work/incept/nova_forge/qwen3-math/docs/inceptml_full_report.md`, line 73).

evidence.quote: - All options are identical (e.g., all 4 choices say "Four thousand five hundred sixty-seven")
- Avoid **equivalent distractors** (e.g., `1/2` vs `5/10`) unless multi-answer is supported.
Synonymous or Near-Synonymous**: Uses different wording but conveys essentially the same meaning

"sentence_0_1": "The phrase long remember suggests that spoken dedications carry minimal lasting weight in human history.",
